curry-coco-poulet.title: Coconut chicken curry
curry-coco-poulet.short: Brown the thighs, soften the aromatics, simmer it all in coconut milk for half an hour. Makes enough for three meals.

ingredients.product: Volaé, une marque Intermarché Cuisse de poulet jaune x4
Lait de coco
Le Choix du Primeur Oignons JAUNES
Le Choix du Primeur Ail BLANC
Gingembre frais
Le Choix du Primeur Carottes
Le Choix du Primeur Poivron ROUGE
Kikkoman Sauce soja salée
Le Choix du Primeur Coriandre
Le Choix du Primeur Citrons JAUNES
Taureau Ailé Riz Basmati

steps: Pat the thighs dry and season. Brown them skin-down in a dry casserole over medium-high heat, 6 minutes, until the skin releases easily. Turn, 3 minutes more, then lift out.
Pour off all but a spoonful of the fat. Soften the sliced onion in it for 5 minutes without letting it colour.
Add the garlic and grated ginger, 1 minute, until it smells like the inside of a good takeaway.
Return the chicken. Pour in both tins of coconut milk and the soy. Bring to a bare simmer — do not let it boil hard or the coconut splits.
Lid on, 20 minutes. Add the carrot coins, 10 minutes more. Add the pepper strips for the last 5 so they keep some bite.
Off the heat, squeeze in the lemon and stir through most of the coriander. Taste for salt.
Serve a third over basmati. The rest is another dinner and a lunch — cool it uncovered before it goes in the fridge.

boeuf-poivrons.title: Beef and green pepper stir-fry
boeuf-poivrons.short: Get the pan properly hot, brown the mince hard without stirring, then peppers, then both soys.

ingredients.product: Jean Rozé, une marque Intermarché Viande hachée vrac pur BŒUF 5% MG
Le Choix du Primeur Poivrons VERTS
Le Choix du Primeur Oignons JAUNES
Le Choix du Primeur Ail BLANC
Gingembre frais
Kikkoman Sauce soja salée
Itinéraire des Saveurs, une marque Intermarché Saveur d'Asie - Sauce soja sucrée
Taureau Ailé Riz Basmati

steps: Start the rice first — everything else takes twelve minutes and will not wait for it.
Get a wide pan very hot with a little oil. Add the mince, then leave it alone for 3 minutes. Resisting the urge to stir is the whole dish; that dark crust is the flavour.
Break it up, another 2 minutes, then push it to one side of the pan.
Onion wedges into the clear side, 2 minutes. Garlic and ginger, 30 seconds.
Peppers in, toss everything together, 3 minutes — they should still squeak.
Both soys down the hot side of the pan so they sizzle and catch, toss once, off the heat.

yakisoba-dinde.title: Turkey yakisoba
yakisoba-dinde.short: Sear the turkey, steam the broccoli bright green, then fold the precooked ramen through soy and sweet soy.

ingredients.product: Le Gaulois Escalope de dinde
Tanoshi Nouilles japonaises précuites Ramen assaisonnement bœuf
Le Choix du Primeur Brocolis
Le Choix du Primeur Carottes
Le Choix du Primeur Oignons JAUNES
Le Choix du Primeur Ail BLANC
Kikkoman Sauce soja salée
Itinéraire des Saveurs, une marque Intermarché Saveur d'Asie - Sauce soja sucrée

steps: Slice the turkey across the grain as thinly as you can manage — it cooks in about ninety seconds that way and stays tender.
Very hot pan, oil, turkey in a single layer. 90 seconds a side, then out onto a plate. It finishes later; do not cook it through now.
Same pan: onion 2 minutes, then broccoli florets and a splash of water, lid on, 3 minutes to steam them bright green.
Lid off, carrot ribbons and garlic, 1 minute.
Loosen the noodles under the tap and add them with their sachet, plus the turkey and any juices.
Both soys, then toss hard for 2 minutes until everything is glossy.

donburi-teriyaki.title: Chicken teriyaki donburi
donburi-teriyaki.short: Chicken glazed in yakitori sauce over rice, with a soft egg broken across the top.

ingredients.product: La Nouvelle Agriculture Aiguillette de poulet
already in the fridge
Itinéraire des Saveurs, une marque Intermarché Sauce Yakitori assaisonnement à base de sauce soja, saké et mirin
Taureau Ailé Riz Basmati
Le Choix du Primeur Brocolis
Tanoshi Feuilles d'algues nori grillées pour sushi

steps: Rice on. Bring a small pan of water to the boil for the eggs.
Six-and-a-half-minute eggs: from the fridge into boiling water, then into cold. The yolk should still be liquid at the centre.
Meanwhile, hot pan, chicken in a single layer, 3 minutes without moving it, turn, 2 minutes.
Pour in the yakitori sauce. It thickens fast — turn the chicken through it for a minute until lacquered, then off before the sugar catches.
Blanch the broccoli in the egg water for 2 minutes.
Rice into deep bowls, chicken and all the pan sauce over, broccoli alongside. Halve the eggs on top, scatter the nori.

gyoza-brocoli.title: Gyoza with garlic-ginger broccoli
gyoza-brocoli.packNote: The gyoza are shop-bought and cook straight from frozen — follow the pack, roughly 3 minutes in oil, 5 under a lid with a splash of water, 2 more with the lid off. There is no recipe to give you for that.
gyoza-brocoli.short: A no-cooking night. The gyoza come from a packet; the only real cooking is the broccoli beside them.

ingredients.product: Ajinomoto Gyoza poulet et légumes raviolis à poêler
Le Choix du Primeur Brocolis
Le Choix du Primeur Ail BLANC
Gingembre frais
Kikkoman Sauce soja salée
Le Choix du Primeur Citrons JAUNES
Taureau Ailé Riz Basmati

steps: The broccoli, which is the part worth doing properly: cut it into florets and get a pan hot with a film of oil.
Florets in, cut face down, and leave them 2 minutes to char in patches. That browning is the whole point of cooking broccoli in a pan rather than boiling it.
Add the sliced garlic, the ginger and a splash of water, clamp a lid on, 3 minutes.
Lid off, a squeeze of lemon, and let any remaining water go.
Serve with the gyoza and rice, soy for dipping.

porc-soja-gingembre.title: Sweet soy and ginger pork chops
porc-soja-gingembre.short: Marinate the chops while the rice cooks, sear them hard, then finish them in the reduced marinade.

ingredients.product: Terroirs, une marque Intermarché Côtes de PORC
Itinéraire des Saveurs, une marque Intermarché Saveur d'Asie - Sauce soja sucrée
Kikkoman Sauce soja salée
Gingembre frais
Le Choix du Primeur Ail BLANC
Le Choix du Primeur Poivron ROUGE
Le Choix du Primeur Oignons JAUNES
Taureau Ailé Riz Basmati

steps: Mix both soys, the grated ginger and the crushed garlic in a shallow dish. Turn the chops through it and leave them while the rice cooks — 20 minutes is plenty, and much longer makes the surface too sweet to sear cleanly.
Lift the chops out and scrape the marinade back into the dish. Keep it.
Very hot pan, a little oil. Chops in, 4 minutes without touching them, until deeply browned. Turn, 3 minutes.
Out onto a warm plate to rest.
Same pan, heat down: onion and pepper, 4 minutes, scraping up everything stuck to the base.
Pour in the reserved marinade and 3 tbsp water. Bubble 2 minutes until syrupy.
Chops back in with any resting juices, turn once to coat, serve over rice.

riz-saute-lardons.title: Egg fried rice with lardons
riz-saute-lardons.short: Yesterday's rice, a very hot pan, lardons for fat and salt, egg scrambled through at the end.

ingredients.product: Taureau Ailé Riz Basmati
Herta Lardons nature
already in the fridge
Le Choix du Primeur Carottes
Le Choix du Primeur Oignons JAUNES
Le Choix du Primeur Ail BLANC
Kikkoman Sauce soja salée

steps: Cold rice is not a suggestion. Warm rice steams and clumps; if you have not got leftovers, cook it an hour ahead and spread it on a tray to cool.
Lardons into a cold wide pan, heat to medium. Let the fat render out for 4 minutes until they are golden, then lift them out and leave the fat behind.
Carrot and onion into that fat, 4 minutes on high. Garlic, 30 seconds.
Rice in, breaking up the clumps with the back of a spatula. Spread it out and leave it a full minute at a time so it toasts rather than steams — 4 minutes in total.
Push everything aside, beat the eggs into the clear space, let them set for 20 seconds, then fold them through.
Lardons back in, soy round the edge of the pan, one more toss.

poulet-citron-gingembre.title: Lemon and ginger chicken
poulet-citron-gingembre.short: Chicken strips in a sharp lemon-soy glaze that thickens in the pan. Brighter than teriyaki.

ingredients.product: Le Gaulois Filet de poulet extra tendre
Le Choix du Primeur Citrons JAUNES
Gingembre frais
Le Choix du Primeur Ail BLANC
Kikkoman Sauce soja salée
Le Choix du Primeur Brocolis
Taureau Ailé Riz Basmati

steps: Zest both lemons before you juice them — it is the zest, not the juice, that carries the perfume.
Toss the chicken strips with a spoonful of flour and a pinch of salt. The flour is what thickens the sauce later.
Hot pan, oil, chicken in one layer. 3 minutes, turn, 2 minutes, then out.
Ginger and garlic in the same pan, 30 seconds.
Lemon juice, soy, a teaspoon of sugar and 100 ml water. Scrape the base and let it bubble down for 2 minutes until it coats a spoon.
Chicken and zest back in, turn to coat. Broccoli steamed alongside, rice underneath.

dahl-lentilles-coco.title: Coconut lentil dahl
dahl-lentilles-coco.short: Tinned lentils, coconut milk and warm spices, simmered until it thickens. Mild by design — the warmth is cumin and coriander, never heat.

ingredients.product: Saint Eloi, une marque Intermarché Lentilles préparées
Lait de coco
Le Choix du Primeur Oignons JAUNES
Le Choix du Primeur Ail BLANC
Gingembre frais
Le Choix du Primeur Tomate RONDE en GRAPPE
already in the cupboard — the mild tandoori
Le Choix du Primeur Coriandre
Taureau Ailé Riz Basmati

steps: Soften the onion in oil over medium heat for a full 8 minutes. Rushing this is the difference between a dahl that tastes sweet and one that tastes raw.
Garlic, ginger and the curry powder, 1 minute, stirring — the spices need the hot oil to open up.
Tomatoes in, cook them down for 5 minutes until they collapse and the oil separates out at the edges.
Drained lentils and the coconut milk. Simmer uncovered, 12 minutes, stirring now and then so it does not catch.
It should be thick enough to hold a furrow when you drag the spoon through. Loosen with water if it goes past that.
Salt properly — lentils take more than you expect — and stir the coriander through at the end.

pho-express-boeuf.title: Quick beef noodle soup
pho-express-boeuf.short: A cheat's phở: charred onion and ginger in the broth for twenty minutes, then raw beef cooked by the heat of it in the bowl.

ingredients.product: Jean Rozé, une marque Intermarché Viande hachée vrac pur BŒUF 5% MG
Suzi Wan Vermicelles de riz
Le Choix du Primeur Oignons JAUNES
Gingembre frais
Kikkoman Sauce soja salée
Le Choix du Primeur Coriandre
Le Choix du Primeur Citrons JAUNES
Le Choix du Primeur Carottes

steps: Char the onion and ginger halves cut-side down in a dry pan for 4 minutes, until properly blackened in patches. This is where the whole flavour of the broth comes from, so let them go further than feels right.
Add 1.2 litres of water, the soy, a cinnamon stick if you have one, and a teaspoon of sugar. Simmer 20 minutes.
Meanwhile soak the vermicelli in just-boiled water for 4 minutes, drain, and divide between two deep bowls.
Brown the beef hard in a separate pan, 4 minutes, and put it on the noodles.
Fish out the onion and ginger. Taste the broth — it should be a little too savoury on its own, because the noodles will flatten it.
Pour the boiling broth over. Carrot ribbons, a mountain of coriander, lemon at the table.

aubergines-miso-soja.title: Sticky glazed aubergine
aubergines-miso-soja.short: Aubergine roasted until genuinely collapsing, then glazed with sweet soy until it turns lacquered.

ingredients.product: Le Choix du Primeur Aubergines VIOLETTES
Itinéraire des Saveurs, une marque Intermarché Saveur d'Asie - Sauce soja sucrée
Kikkoman Sauce soja salée
Gingembre frais
Le Choix du Primeur Ail BLANC
already in the fridge
Tanoshi Riz pour sushi Japonica

steps: Oven to 220°C. Score the cut faces in a diamond pattern, about a centimetre deep, without cutting the skin.
Oil them generously — aubergine drinks it, and underoiled aubergine goes leathery rather than silky — and roast cut-side down for 15 minutes.
Mix the sweet soy, soy, grated ginger and crushed garlic.
Turn the halves over, spoon the glaze into the scored faces, and roast 7 minutes more until the tops are dark and bubbling.
Serve on rice with a soft egg, spooning the pan juices over.

gratin-courgettes.title: Courgette and emmental gratin
gratin-courgettes.short: Courgettes cooked down hard to drive off their water, bound with egg and emmental, baked till the top blisters. No cream.

ingredients.product: Petit prix Courgettes
Pâturages, une marque Intermarché Emmental français au lait français
already in the fridge
Le Choix du Primeur Oignons JAUNES
Le Choix du Primeur Ail BLANC
Taureau Ailé Riz Basmati

steps: Oven to 200°C. Slice the courgettes into rounds and salt them in a colander for 10 minutes while the oven heats.
Soften the onion in a wide pan, 6 minutes. Add the courgettes, squeezed dry, and the garlic.

Now cook them hard for 12 minutes on a high heat, stirring occasionally. You want them collapsing and starting to brown, with no liquid left in the pan. A watery gratin is a gratin that went into the oven too soon.
Off the heat, stir in the cooked rice and two-thirds of the emmental, then the beaten eggs. Season well.
Into a baking dish, the rest of the cheese on top.
30 minutes until set and blistered. Let it stand 10 minutes before cutting — it slices instead of slumping.

gnocchi-pesto.title: Pan-fried gnocchi with pesto rosso
gnocchi-pesto.short: Gnocchi crisped in a dry pan rather than boiled, tossed with pesto rosso and burst cherry tomatoes.

ingredients.product: Lustucru Sélection Gnocchi à poêler croustillant et moelleux format XXL
Barilla Sauce pesto rosso
Petit prix Tomates cerises allongées
Pâturages, une marque Intermarché Mozzarella
Le Choix du Primeur Ail BLANC

steps: Gnocchi straight into a hot pan with oil, no boiling, no water. Spread them in one layer.
Leave them 4 minutes untouched so a crust forms, then shake and give them 3 more.
Push to one side, cherry tomatoes into the space, 3 minutes until they split and weep.
Garlic, 30 seconds, then toss everything together with the pesto rosso and a splash of water to loosen it.
Off the heat, tear the mozzarella over so it softens without turning to rubber.

farfalles-pesto-poulet.title: Farfalle with pesto and chicken
farfalles-pesto-poulet.short: Weeknight pasta, done properly: pasta water in the sauce, cheese off the heat.

ingredients.product: Fiorini, une marque Intermarché Pâtes farfalles
La Nouvelle Agriculture Aiguillette de poulet
Barilla Sauce pesto rosso
Itinéraire des Saveurs, une marque Intermarché Parmigiano Reggiano AOP râpé
Petit prix Tomates cerises allongées

steps: Pasta into well-salted boiling water. Set a timer a minute under the packet time.
Meanwhile brown the chicken in a wide pan, 3 minutes a side, and cut it into pieces.
Tomatoes into the chicken pan, 3 minutes until they collapse.
Lift the pasta straight across with a spider or tongs, dripping wet, plus a ladle of the water. Do not drain it into the sink — that starchy water is what makes the sauce cling.
Pesto in off the heat, toss hard for a minute until it goes glossy rather than oily.
Parmesan at the table.

pizza-maison.title: Tomato and mozzarella pizza
pizza-maison.short: Bought dough, but everything on top is yours. The trick is the hottest oven you have and a preheated tray.

ingredients.product: Croustipate Pâte à pizza qualité comme à la pizzeria
Panzani Sauce Tomates Cuisinées ingrédients origine naturelle
Pâturages, une marque Intermarché Mozzarella
Petit prix Tomates cerises allongées
Le Choix du Primeur Ail BLANC

steps: Oven as hot as it goes, with the baking tray already inside. A cold tray is why home pizza goes soggy underneath.
Tear the mozzarella and leave it on kitchen paper for 10 minutes. Wet mozzarella floods the pizza.
Sauce over the dough, thin — a bare spoonful spread to the edges. Grate the garlic into it.
Slide the dough onto the hot tray, mozzarella and halved cherry tomatoes over.
12 to 15 minutes until the edge is blistered and the base lifts stiff off the tray.

poulet-roti-legumes.title: Roast chicken legs with lemon
poulet-roti-legumes.short: One tray, forty-five minutes, no attention. Potatoes cook in the chicken fat underneath.

ingredients.product: Plukon Pilons de poulet
Le Choix du Primeur Pomme de terre de consommation PRINCESSE AMANDINE à chair ferme avec traitement anti germinatif
Le Choix du Primeur Citrons JAUNES
Le Choix du Primeur Ail BLANC
Le Choix du Primeur Oignons JAUNES
Le Choix du Primeur Haricots VERTS EBOUTES

steps: Oven to 200°C. Potatoes, onion wedges and unpeeled garlic cloves in a big roasting tin with oil and salt.
Sit the drumsticks on top so the fat drips down into the potatoes, and tuck the lemon wedges between them.
45 minutes, turning the potatoes once at the half hour.
The chicken is done when the skin is genuinely crisp and the thickest part gives no pink juice.
Green beans boiled for 6 minutes at the very end. Squeeze the roasted garlic out of its skins over everything.

tortilla-pommes-terre.title: Potato tortilla
tortilla-pommes-terre.short: Potatoes poached soft in oil, then set with eggs into a thick, just-runny cake. Good hot, better at room temperature.

ingredients.product: Le Choix du Primeur Pomme de terre de consommation PRINCESSE AMANDINE à chair ferme avec traitement anti germinatif
already in the fridge
Le Choix du Primeur Oignons JAUNES
Le Choix du Primeur Laitue FEUILLES DE CHENES BLONDE

steps: Slice the potatoes about 3 mm thick. Warm a generous amount of oil in a 24 cm pan over medium-low heat.
Potatoes and onion into the oil. You are poaching, not frying — they should barely sizzle. 18 minutes, turning gently, until a slice crushes against the pan.
Drain them, keeping a spoonful of the oil. Beat the eggs with plenty of salt and fold the hot potatoes in. Let it sit 5 minutes; the potato drinks the egg and that is what holds it together.
Reserved oil in the pan on medium. Everything in, flatten the top, 4 minutes until the edge sets.
The flip: plate over the pan, invert with confidence rather than care, slide it back in.
3 minutes more. The centre should still wobble slightly. Rest 10 minutes before cutting.

saucisses-lentilles.title: Chipolatas with lentils
saucisses-lentilles.short: Sausages browned properly, lentils warmed through in the pan they came out of. A twenty-minute plate of real food.

ingredients.product: Jean Rozé, une marque Intermarché Chipolata supérieure aux herbes
Saint Eloi, une marque Intermarché Lentilles préparées
Le Choix du Primeur Carottes
Le Choix du Primeur Céleri BRANCHE VERT
Le Choix du Primeur Oignons JAUNES
Maille Cornichons extra-fins L'Original

steps: Chipolatas into a cold pan with a little oil, then medium heat. Starting cold renders the fat instead of splitting the skins. 10 minutes, turning, until browned all over. Out onto a plate.
Carrot, celery and onion into the sausage fat. 8 minutes until soft and just catching.
Drained lentils in with a splash of water, 3 minutes to warm through and pick up everything in the pan.
Season hard — lentils are flat without enough salt and a good grind of pepper.
Sausages back on top, cornichons on the side for the sharpness.

bolognaise-maison.title: Slow-ish bolognese
bolognaise-maison.short: Mince browned properly, softened vegetables, tomatoes given long enough to stop tasting of tin.

ingredients.product: Jean Rozé, une marque Intermarché Viande hachée vrac pur BŒUF 5% MG
Herta Lardons nature
Panzani Sauce Tomates Cuisinées ingrédients origine naturelle
Le Choix du Primeur Carottes
Le Choix du Primeur Céleri BRANCHE VERT
Le Choix du Primeur Oignons JAUNES
Fiorini, une marque Intermarché Pâtes farfalles
Itinéraire des Saveurs, une marque Intermarché Parmigiano Reggiano AOP râpé

steps: Lardons into a cold heavy pot, medium heat, 5 minutes until the fat runs.
Carrot, celery and onion in, 8 minutes until soft. This is the base; if it is still crunchy the sauce will taste thin no matter how long you cook it.
Push aside, mince into the space, and leave it to brown for 4 minutes before breaking it up.
Tomato sauce plus half a jar of water. Simmer, lid ajar, 20 minutes.
Taste. If it is sharp, a pinch of sugar; if it is flat, more salt.
Pasta cooked a minute under, finished in the sauce with a splash of its water. Parmesan at the table.

parmigiana-aubergines.title: Aubergine parmigiana
parmigiana-aubergines.short: Roast the aubergine rather than frying it, layer with tomato and mozzarella, bake until the edges catch.

ingredients.product: Le Choix du Primeur Aubergines VIOLETTES
Panzani Sauce Tomates Cuisinées ingrédients origine naturelle
Pâturages, une marque Intermarché Mozzarella
Itinéraire des Saveurs, une marque Intermarché Parmigiano Reggiano AOP râpé
Le Choix du Primeur Ail BLANC
Cuit sur place Baguette La Généreuse

steps: Oven to 220°C. Slice the aubergines lengthways about 1 cm thick, brush both sides with oil, spread on two trays.
Roast 20 minutes until browned and floppy. Roasting rather than frying is the difference between a parmigiana you can eat and one swimming in oil.
Warm the tomato sauce with the crushed garlic for 5 minutes.
Layer in a dish: sauce, aubergine, torn mozzarella, a little parmesan. Repeat, finishing with sauce and all the remaining parmesan.
Bake 15 minutes at 200°C until the top is bubbling and dark at the corners.
Rest 10 minutes. Bread to wipe the dish.

tartine-mortadelle.title: Grilled mortadella and mozzarella tartine
tartine-mortadelle.short: Split baguette under the grill with mozzarella, mortadella folded on at the end so it stays soft.

ingredients.product: Cuit sur place Baguette La Généreuse
Montorsi Mortadelle
Pâturages, une marque Intermarché Mozzarella
Petit prix Tomates cerises allongées
Le Choix du Primeur Laitue FEUILLES DE CHENES BLONDE

steps: Grill on high. Split the baguette lengthways and toast the cut faces for 2 minutes.
Torn mozzarella and halved cherry tomatoes over, back under for 5 minutes until the cheese is molten and blistered in spots.
Out of the grill, then drape the mortadella over in loose folds. It should warm from the bread, not cook — grilled mortadella goes tough and loses its point.
Black pepper, olive oil, and the salad alongside.

soupe-legumes.title: Winter vegetable soup
soupe-legumes.short: Everything in the drawer, softened in butter first so it tastes of more than hot water.

ingredients.product: Le Choix du Primeur Pomme de terre de consommation PRINCESSE AMANDINE à chair ferme avec traitement anti germinatif
Le Choix du Primeur Carottes
Le Choix du Primeur Céleri BRANCHE VERT
Petit prix Courgettes
Le Choix du Primeur Oignons JAUNES
Pâturages, une marque Intermarché Beurre moulé demi-sel
Cuit sur place Baguette La Généreuse

steps: Everything chopped roughly the same size so it cooks evenly. Precision is not the point; consistency is.
Butter in a big pot, onion and celery, 8 minutes on medium without browning.
Carrot, potato and courgette, another 3 minutes, stirring so they take on some of the butter.
Water to just cover — no more, or you dilute it. Simmer 20 minutes until the potato falls apart against the spoon.
Blend, or leave it chunky. Season hard, and a final knob of butter stirred in off the heat.
Bread on the side.

onigiri-oeuf.title: Egg and nori onigiri
onigiri-oeuf.short: Sushi rice pressed around a soy-seasoned egg, wrapped in nori. Better at room temperature than cold.

ingredients.product: Tanoshi Riz pour sushi Japonica
already in the fridge
Tanoshi Feuilles d'algues nori grillées pour sushi
Kikkoman Sauce soja salée
Le Choix du Primeur Concombre

steps: Rinse the rice in cold water until it runs almost clear — four or five changes. This is what stops the onigiri turning gluey.
Cook it, then let it sit off the heat with the lid on for 10 minutes. Season with the soy while warm, fanning as you fold.
Hard-boil the eggs, 9 minutes. Cool, peel, chop roughly.
Wet your hands. Flatten a handful of rice in your palm, a spoonful of egg in the middle, close the rice over it.
Press into a triangle by cupping one hand at a right angle and turning a third at a time. Three turns, firm but not crushing.
A band of nori round the base of each. They keep until lunchtime at room temperature.

bun-vermicelles.title: Bún noodle salad with peanuts
bun-vermicelles.short: Vermicelli softened in hot water, raw vegetables and herbs piled on, sweet soy and lemon dressing, crushed peanuts.

ingredients.product: Suzi Wan Vermicelles de riz
Le Choix du Primeur Concombre
Le Choix du Primeur Carottes
Le Choix du Primeur Coriandre
Menguy's Cacahuètes grillées et salées
Itinéraire des Saveurs, une marque Intermarché Saveur d'Asie - Sauce soja sucrée
Le Choix du Primeur Citrons JAUNES

steps: Cover the vermicelli with just-boiled water, 4 minutes, then drain and rinse under cold water until completely cool. Warm noodles wilt the herbs.
Whisk sweet soy, lemon juice, grated garlic and 2 tbsp water. It should taste sharper than you expect — the noodles flatten it.
Noodles in the bottom of the box. Cucumber and carrot in separate piles, coriander over everything.
Crush the peanuts under the flat of a knife and scatter.
If it is travelling, keep the dressing in a jar and pour it at the table.

salade-mache-oeuf.title: Mâche and egg salad, sesame-soy
salade-mache-oeuf.short: Soft eggs on a pile of mâche with a soy and lemon dressing. Ten minutes, most of it waiting for the eggs.

ingredients.product: Le Choix du Primeur Salade MACHE BIO
already in the fridge
Le Choix du Primeur Concombre
Le Choix du Primeur Carottes
Kikkoman Sauce soja salée
Menguy's Cacahuètes grillées et salées

steps: Six-and-a-half-minute eggs, from the fridge into boiling water, then straight into cold.
Dressing: soy, a squeeze of lemon, a spoonful of oil, whisked until it thickens slightly.
Mâche in the bowl — dress it at the very last moment, it collapses fast.
Cucumber and grated carrot over the top.
Peel and halve the eggs, set them on, crushed peanuts, a grind of pepper.

baguette-boursin.title: Baguette, Boursin and cucumber
baguette-boursin.short: The one lunch that is not a project. Good bread, garlic cheese, cold cucumber.

ingredients.product: Cuit sur place Baguette La Généreuse
Boursin Fromage à tartiner ail et fines herbes
Le Choix du Primeur Concombre
Le Choix du Primeur Salade MACHE BIO

steps: Split the baguette lengthways but not all the way through.
Boursin on both cut faces, thickly.
Cucumber in overlapping slices, mâche pressed in on top.
Wrap tightly in paper and leave it half an hour if you can — better once the bread has softened against the cheese.

salade-pois-chiches.title: Chickpea and brebis salad
salade-pois-chiches.short: Chickpeas, cucumber, tomato and sheep's cheese. Improves in the fridge, so make it the night before.

ingredients.product: Saint Eloi, une marque Intermarché Pois chiches français
Salakis Fromage 100% brebis herbes de Provence
Le Choix du Primeur Concombre
Le Choix du Primeur Tomate RONDE en GRAPPE
Le Choix du Primeur Oignons ROUGES
Le Choix du Primeur Citrons JAUNES

steps: Drain and rinse the chickpeas properly — the tinning liquid is what makes chickpea salads taste dull.
Cucumber and tomato in rough chunks, not neat dice. Salt the tomato now and let it sit; it draws out juice that becomes half the dressing.
Red onion sliced as thin as you can, rinsed under cold water for 10 seconds to take the raw edge off.
Everything together with the oil from the cheese jar, lemon juice and plenty of pepper.
Cheese cubes folded through last so they keep their shape.

salade-lentilles.title: Lentil and cornichon salad
salade-lentilles.short: Tinned lentils turned into something worth eating by mustard, cornichons and enough acid.

ingredients.product: Saint Eloi, une marque Intermarché Lentilles préparées
Maille Cornichons extra-fins L'Original
Le Choix du Primeur Carottes
Le Choix du Primeur Céleri BRANCHE VERT
already in the fridge
Le Choix du Primeur Salade MACHE BIO

steps: Drain the lentils and rinse them. Tip them into the bowl while you make the dressing so they drain fully.
Dressing: a heaped teaspoon of mustard, a spoonful of the cornichon vinegar, two of oil. Whisk until it goes thick and pale.
Lentils, grated carrot, celery and chopped cornichons folded through.
Season generously and leave it 10 minutes — lentils absorb dressing and taste under-seasoned straight away.
Mâche and a halved egg on top at the last moment.

sandwich-mortadelle.title: Mortadella and cornichon sandwich
sandwich-mortadelle.short: Folded mortadella, sharp cornichons, butter not mayonnaise. Five minutes.

ingredients.product: Cuit sur place Baguette La Généreuse
Montorsi Mortadelle
Maille Cornichons extra-fins L'Original
Pâturages, une marque Intermarché Beurre moulé demi-sel
Le Choix du Primeur Laitue FEUILLES DE CHENES BLONDE

steps: Butter both faces of the split baguette, properly thick. Butter and not mayonnaise: it waterproofs the bread so the sandwich survives to lunchtime.
Mortadella folded into loose ruffles rather than laid flat — it eats better with air in it.
Cornichons sliced lengthways along the length of the sandwich so every bite gets one.
Lettuce, close it, press it firmly, wrap in paper.

riz-saute-restes.title: Leftovers fried rice
riz-saute-restes.short: Whatever is left, cold rice, one egg, soy. The most useful ten minutes in the week.

ingredients.product: Taureau Ailé Riz Basmati
already in the fridge
Le Choix du Primeur Carottes
Le Choix du Primeur Oignons JAUNES
Kikkoman Sauce soja salée

steps: Hot pan, oil, onion and carrot for 3 minutes.
Cold rice in, broken up, spread flat and left for a minute at a time so it toasts — 3 minutes total.
Push aside, egg beaten into the space, 20 seconds, then folded through.
Soy round the edge of the pan, one toss, done. Add any leftover meat or vegetables with the rice.

salade-avocat-oeuf.title: Avocado, egg and mâche
salade-avocat-oeuf.short: Three good things and a sharp dressing. Assemble at the last minute or the avocado turns.

ingredients.product: Le Choix du Primeur Avocat AFFINE
already in the fridge
Le Choix du Primeur Salade MACHE BIO
Petit prix Tomates cerises allongées
Le Choix du Primeur Citrons JAUNES
Cuit sur place Baguette La Généreuse

steps: Six-and-a-half-minute eggs, then into cold water.
Avocado sliced in the skin and scooped out in one piece with a spoon — cleaner than peeling it.
Lemon over the avocado immediately, before anything else. That is what keeps it green.
Mâche, halved tomatoes, avocado, halved eggs. Olive oil, salt, a lot of pepper.
Bread on the side.

salade-tomates-mozzarella.title: Tomato and mozzarella
salade-tomates-mozzarella.short: Three ingredients, so all of it rests on salting the tomatoes early and using enough oil.

ingredients.product: Le Choix du Primeur Tomates RONDES CHARNUES
Pâturages, une marque Intermarché Mozzarella
Cuit sur place Baguette La Généreuse
Le Choix du Primeur Laitue FEUILLES DE CHENES BLONDE

steps: Thick tomato slices onto the plate, salted, and left for 10 minutes. They release juice that mixes with the oil into a dressing you did not have to make.
Tear the mozzarella rather than slicing it — the ragged edges hold the oil.
Olive oil, black pepper. No vinegar; the tomato is acid enough.
Bread to mop the plate.

roules-cannelle.title: Cinnamon rolls from pizza dough
roules-cannelle.short: A rolled pizza dough, salted butter, cassonade and cinnamon, cut into ten and baked. Sunday morning's job, all week's breakfast.

ingredients.product: Croustipate Pâte à pizza qualité comme à la pizzeria
Cassonade
Cannelle moulue
already in the fridge
already in the fridge

steps: Take the butter out an hour ahead. Cold butter tears the dough instead of spreading on it.
Heat the oven to 200 °C. Unroll the dough on its own paper, long side towards you, and leave it on the paper — it is what you will bake on.
Spread the soft butter right to the edges, then scatter the cassonade and cinnamon evenly over it. Press it in lightly with your palm so it does not all fall out when you roll.
Roll up from the long side, fairly snug but not tight, and pinch the seam shut. Roll the log seam-down.
Cut into 10 with a serrated knife, sawing rather than pressing, and lay them cut-side up with a good gap between — they spread. Squash each one down slightly.
Brush the tops with almond milk and bake 18–20 minutes, until the tops are set and the edges are properly brown. The pale ones are underdone in the middle.
Cool on the tray 5 minutes; the centres firm up as they go. Freeze what you will not eat in two days, and take one out the night before or give it 30 seconds in the microwave.

sandwich-matin.title: The morning baguette
sandwich-matin.packNote: Nothing here is cooked — the baguette, the charcuterie and the Boursin all come as they are. The only real technique is warming the bread and salting the tomatoes.
sandwich-matin.short: The sandwich you actually eat every morning: baguette, Boursin, charcuterie, cheese and cherry tomatoes.

ingredients.product: Cuit sur place Baguette La Généreuse
Boursin Fromage à tartiner ail et fines herbes
Montorsi Mortadelle
Petit prix Tomates cerises allongées
Pâturages, une marque Intermarché Cheddar Les Tranchettes
already in the cupboard

steps: Warm the baguette for 4 minutes in a hot oven if it is yesterday's. A revived crust is the difference between a sandwich and a chore.
Split it lengthways, not all the way through, so it holds together in your hand.
Boursin on the bottom half, right to the ends — it is the only thing keeping the tomatoes from soaking the bread.
Halve the cherry tomatoes, salt them on the board, and give them a minute. Salting first draws out the water that would otherwise run into the crumb.
Charcuterie in loose folds rather than flat sheets, cheese over, then the tomatoes cut-side down.
Plenty of black pepper, close, press gently, eat.

truite-amandes-poireaux.title: Trout with almonds and leeks
truite-amandes-poireaux.short: Trout crisped skin-side down, almonds browned in the pan butter. Méré only sells leeks in a jar, already cooked — which for once saves you twelve minutes.

ingredients.product: Notre Sélection Filet de truite
Parole gourmande Blancs de poireaux
Amandes effilées
Le Choix du Primeur Citrons JAUNES
Le Choix du Primeur Pomme de terre de consommation PRINCESSE AMANDINE à chair ferme avec traitement anti germinatif
already in the fridge

steps: Potatoes on to boil first; everything else takes fifteen minutes and will not wait.
Drain the leek whites well and pat them dry, then cut them into 2 cm lengths. They come out of the jar already cooked and quite wet — dry them or they will steam in the pan instead of colouring.

Melt a knob of butter in a wide pan over medium heat and lay the leeks in cut-side down. 4 minutes, undisturbed, until the cut faces catch and go gold. That browning is the only thing you can add to a jarred vegetable, so do not skip it.
Push them to one side. Pat the trout dry, season, and lay it skin-down in the hot part of the pan. 4 minutes without touching it, until the skin lifts away cleanly by itself.
Turn, 90 seconds, then lift onto the plates.
Almonds into the pan, 1 minute until they smell toasted and go pale gold, then the lemon juice, which will hiss and lift everything off the base.
Spoon the almonds and pan juices over, leeks and potatoes alongside.

poulet-basquaise.title: Poulet basquaise
poulet-basquaise.short: Chicken braised with three colours of pepper, tomato and onion until it falls off the bone. The Basque original leans on piment d'Espelette; this one does not, and does not miss it.

ingredients.product: Volaé, une marque Intermarché Cuisse de poulet jaune x4
Le Choix du Primeur Poivron ROUGE
Le Choix du Primeur Poivrons JAUNES
Le Choix du Primeur Poivrons VERTS
Le Choix du Primeur Tomate RONDE en GRAPPE
Le Choix du Primeur Oignons JAUNES
Le Choix du Primeur Ail BLANC
Vin blanc sec de cuisine
Thym frais
Taureau Ailé Riz Basmati

steps: Season the thighs and brown them skin-down in a dry casserole, 7 minutes, until the skin is properly gold. Do not crowd the pan — steam instead of colour and the whole dish stays pale.
Out onto a plate. Pour off all but a spoonful of the fat.
Onions in, 6 minutes on medium. Then all three peppers in strips, 8 minutes, until they slump and start to catch at the edges.
Garlic and thyme, 1 minute. Wine in, and scrape the base clean while it bubbles down by half.
Tomatoes in, chicken back on top with any juices, lid on, 25 minutes at a bare simmer.
Lid off for the last 5 to thicken the sauce. Taste hard for salt — peppers and tomato both swallow it.
Serve over rice. It is better the next day, so it seeds a second dinner.

gratin-patates-douces-chevre.title: Sweet potato and goat's cheese gratin
gratin-patates-douces-chevre.short: Sweet potato sliced thin, layered with goat's cheese and thyme, baked till the edges caramelise. No cream in it.

ingredients.product: Le Choix du Primeur Patates DOUCES
Bûche de chèvre
Le Choix du Primeur Oignons JAUNES
Le Choix du Primeur Ail BLANC
Pâturages, une marque Intermarché 3 fromages râpés
Thym frais
Saint Eloi, une marque Intermarché Roquette prête à l'emploi déjà lavée

steps: Oven to 200°C. Slice the sweet potatoes into 3 mm rounds — thinner than feels necessary, or they will still be firm when the top is done.
Soften the onions in olive oil for 8 minutes with a good pinch of salt, then stir in the garlic and thyme leaves.
Layer into a dish: sweet potato, a scatter of onion, torn goat's cheese, seasoning. Repeat, finishing with sweet potato.
Grated cheese over the top, cover with foil, 25 minutes.
Foil off, 10 minutes more, until the top is blistered and the edges have gone dark and sweet. That caramelised rim is the best part of the dish; do not pull it early.
Stand 10 minutes before cutting, and serve with the rocket dressed in oil and lemon.

omelette-champignons.title: Mushroom and emmental omelette
omelette-champignons.short: Mushrooms browned properly first, eggs barely set around them, still baveuse in the middle.

ingredients.product: Volaé, une marque Intermarché Œufs frais de poules élevées au sol
Champignons de Paris
Pâturages, une marque Intermarché Emmental français râpé
Persil plat
Le Choix du Primeur Salade MACHE
already in the fridge

steps: Slice the mushrooms thickly and put them into a dry hot pan with no fat at all. They release their water; let it boil off, 4 minutes. Adding fat first makes them stew in it.
Once the pan is dry again, butter in, 2 minutes, until they are properly brown. Salt now, not before — salt early pulls out more water.
Beat the eggs with a fork just until the yolks break up. Over-beating makes a rubbery omelette.
Eggs over the mushrooms on a medium heat, and drag the setting edges into the middle with a spatula for about 90 seconds.
Emmental and parsley over one half while the top is still glossy and wet. Fold, slide onto a plate, and let the residual heat finish it.

risotto-safran.title: Saffron risotto
risotto-safran.short: Risotto alla milanese: rice, stock, saffron, parmesan. Twenty minutes of stirring and nothing to hide behind.

ingredients.product: Riz Arborio pour risotto
Safran en dosettes
Bouillon de légumes en cubes
Vin blanc sec de cuisine
Échalotes
Itinéraire des Saveurs, une marque Intermarché Parmigiano Reggiano AOP
already in the fridge

steps: Steep the saffron in a ladleful of the hot stock and leave it. Adding the threads dry gives you yellow streaks instead of an evenly perfumed pot.
Soften the shallots in butter on a low heat for 5 minutes without colouring them.
Rice in, and stir it for a full 2 minutes until the grains look translucent at the edges with a white dot at the centre. This toasting is what keeps them separate later.
Wine in, stir until it has all gone.
Now a ladle of hot stock at a time, stirring, waiting until each is nearly absorbed before the next. About 18 minutes. Add the saffron stock halfway.
When the rice is tender with the faintest bite, take it off the heat, beat in the butter and parmesan hard, and let it sit 2 minutes. That final beating is what makes it creamy, not cream.
It should spread slowly on the plate. If it stands up in a mound, loosen it with another splash of stock.

carbonara-pancetta.title: Carbonara, the Roman way
carbonara-pancetta.short: Egg yolks, pancetta, pecorino and pasta water. No cream anywhere near it — which is also why it sits well with you.

ingredients.product: Pastificio Liguori Pâtes fusilli
Pancetta en dés
Volaé, une marque Intermarché Œufs frais de poules élevées au sol
Itinéraire des Saveurs, une marque Intermarché Parmigiano Reggiano AOP
already in the cupboard

steps: Pasta into well-salted boiling water. Time it — everything else is faster than the pasta.
Pancetta into a cold pan, heat to medium, and let the fat render out for 6 minutes until the cubes are crisp. Starting cold is what gets the fat out instead of burning the outside.
Beat the yolks, the whole egg, the parmesan and an aggressive amount of black pepper into a paste in a bowl.
Scoop out a mugful of pasta water before draining. This is the one step people skip and the one that matters.
Drain the pasta, tip it into the pancetta pan OFF THE HEAT, and toss for 30 seconds so the pan cools slightly.

Now the egg mixture, and toss hard, adding pasta water a splash at a time until it turns into a glossy sauce that coats every piece. Off the heat throughout — on the heat you get scrambled egg, and there is no coming back from it.

lasagnes-legumes-ricotta.title: Courgette and ricotta lasagne
lasagnes-legumes-ricotta.short: Ricotta instead of béchamel — lighter, faster, and no milk sauce to split.

ingredients.product: Barilla Pâtes Lasagne aux œufs - Collezione
Pâturages, une marque Intermarché Ricotta
Le Choix du Primeur Courgettes LONGUES
Le Choix du Primeur Aubergines VIOLETTES
Panzani Sauce Tomates Basilic ingrédients origine naturelle
Le Choix du Primeur Oignons JAUNES
Le Choix du Primeur Ail BLANC
Pâturages, une marque Intermarché Emmental français râpé
Basilic frais en pot

steps: Oven to 190°C. Cook the courgette and aubergine hard in olive oil, in two batches so they brown rather than steam, 10 minutes in total. Crowding the pan here is what makes a watery lasagne.
Add the onion and garlic for the last 3 minutes, then the tomato sauce and a splash of water. Simmer 5 minutes.
Beat the ricotta with salt, pepper and half the basil until it is spreadable.
Layer: vegetables, sheets, ricotta spread thin, and repeat. Finish with vegetables, then the grated cheese.
40 minutes, until the top is brown and a knife goes through the sheets with no resistance.
Rest 15 minutes before cutting. Straight out of the oven it slumps; rested, it slices.

puttanesca-sans-piment.title: Puttanesca, without the heat
puttanesca-sans-piment.short: Anchovies melted into oil, olives, capers, tomato. The classic carries peperoncino; this one leaves it out and leans harder on the anchovy instead.

ingredients.product: Pastificio Liguori Pâtes fusilli
Filets d'anchois à l'huile
Olives noires dénoyautées
Câpres au vinaigre
Panzani Sauce Tomates Provençale ingrédients origine naturelle
Le Choix du Primeur Ail BLANC
Persil plat

steps: Pasta on. Salt the water properly but go easy — anchovies, olives and capers are all salty and the sauce catches up fast.
Garlic into cold olive oil over a low heat, 2 minutes, until it just turns blond. Hot oil burns it in seconds and turns the whole dish bitter.
Anchovies in, and press them with a wooden spoon. They will dissolve completely in about a minute — that is the point, and why nobody eating it will identify them.
Olives and capers, 1 minute, then the tomato sauce. Simmer 8 minutes.
Drain the pasta a minute early, keeping a mugful of water, and finish it in the sauce for that last minute with a splash of the water.
Parsley through at the end. Taste before you add any salt at all.

salade-roquette-parmesan-pommes.title: Rocket, parmesan and green apple
salade-roquette-parmesan-pommes.short: Peppery rocket, sharp apple, salty parmesan shards and toasted pine nuts. Three minutes if the pine nuts are already done.

ingredients.product: Saint Eloi, une marque Intermarché Roquette prête à l'emploi déjà lavée
Le Choix du Primeur Pommes GRANNY SMITH
Itinéraire des Saveurs, une marque Intermarché Parmigiano Reggiano AOP
Pignons de pin
Vinaigre balsamique
Cuit sur place Baguette La Généreuse
already in the cupboard

steps: Toast the pine nuts in a dry pan for 2 minutes, shaking constantly. They go from pale to burnt in about fifteen seconds, so do not walk away.
Cut the apple into matchsticks at the last moment and toss them in a little of the balsamic, which stops them browning.
Dress the rocket with olive oil first, then a little balsamic, then salt. Oil before acid coats the leaves and stops them collapsing.
Shave the parmesan over with a peeler — shards, not gratings, so you get a proper salty hit now and then.
Pine nuts over, black pepper, and the baguette alongside.

pates-saumon-fume-citron.title: Smoked salmon and lemon pasta
pates-saumon-fume-citron.short: The salmon never sees the pan — it goes in off the heat so it stays silky instead of turning to string.

ingredients.product: Pastificio Liguori Pâtes fusilli
Petit navire Saumon fumé de Norvège
Le Choix du Primeur Citrons JAUNES
Pâturages, une marque Intermarché Ricotta
Échalotes
Aneth frais

steps: Pasta on. Zest the lemon before juicing it.
Soften the shallot in olive oil on a low heat, 4 minutes, no colour.
Loosen the ricotta in a bowl with the lemon zest, half the juice, black pepper and two spoonfuls of the pasta water.
Drain the pasta, keeping a mugful of water. Into the shallot pan, off the heat.
Ricotta mixture in, tossing and loosening with pasta water until it coats.
Only now tear in the salmon and fold it through the residual heat, with the herbs. Cook it properly and it seizes into salty threads; warmed like this it stays soft.

tortilla-patatas.title: Tortilla de patatas
tortilla-patatas.short: Potatoes poached soft in olive oil, then set in egg. Eaten hot, warm or cold, and better on day two.

ingredients.product: Le Choix du Primeur Pomme de terre de consommation PRINCESSE AMANDINE à chair ferme avec traitement anti germinatif
Volaé, une marque Intermarché Œufs frais de poules élevées au sol
Le Choix du Primeur Oignons JAUNES
Bouton d’Or, une marque Intermarché Huile d'olive vierge extra BIO - issue de l'agriculture biologique
Le Choix du Primeur Laitue COEUR DE ROMAINE

steps: Slice the potatoes thin. Into a deep pan with enough olive oil to nearly cover them and a big pinch of salt.
Cook them on a low-medium heat for 20 minutes, turning gently now and then. They should never sizzle hard or brown — you are poaching them soft, not frying them. Add the onion halfway.
Drain them through a sieve set over a bowl, and keep that oil; it is now excellent and worth cooking with all week.
Beat the eggs with salt, tip in the hot potatoes, and leave the lot to sit for 10 minutes. This soak is what makes the tortilla hold together instead of falling apart.
Two tablespoons of the reserved oil into a 24 cm non-stick pan on medium. Mixture in, and cook 5 minutes, easing the edges in with a spatula.
Cover with a plate, flip the whole thing over — commit, do not hesitate — slide it back in and give it 3 more minutes. The middle should still be a little loose.

gambas-ail-persil.title: Gambas al ajillo, no chilli
gambas-ail-persil.short: Prawns in garlicky oil, eight minutes start to finish. The Spanish version has a dried guindilla in it; this one has an extra clove of garlic instead.

ingredients.product: Gambas crues décortiquées
Le Choix du Primeur Ail BLANC
Bouton d’Or, une marque Intermarché Huile d'olive vierge extra BIO - issue de l'agriculture biologique
Persil plat
Le Choix du Primeur Citrons JAUNES
Cuit sur place Baguette La Généreuse

steps: Pat the prawns very dry and salt them. Wet prawns steam and go rubbery.
Garlic into cold olive oil in a small pan, then bring it up to a gentle heat over 3 minutes until the slices are pale gold and the oil smells of them. Never let them brown.
Heat up, prawns in one layer, 90 seconds.
Turn them, 60 seconds more, and take the pan off as soon as they have just turned opaque. They keep cooking in the hot oil, so pull them early.
Parsley and a squeeze of lemon in, swirl once.
Straight to the table in the pan, with the baguette. The oil is the point as much as the prawns.

pisto-manchego.title: Pisto with manchego and a fried egg
pisto-manchego.short: Spain's ratatouille — courgette, aubergine, peppers and tomato cooked right down, with a fried egg broken over it.

ingredients.product: Le Choix du Primeur Courgettes LONGUES
Le Choix du Primeur Aubergines VIOLETTES
Le Choix du Primeur Poivron ROUGE
Le Choix du Primeur Poivrons JAUNES
Le Choix du Primeur Tomates RONDES CHARNUES
Le Choix du Primeur Oignons JAUNES
Le Choix du Primeur Ail BLANC
Volaé, une marque Intermarché Œufs frais de poules élevées au sol
Manchego
Cuit sur place Baguette La Généreuse

steps: Cube everything to roughly the same size. Salt the aubergine in a colander while you do the rest.
Onions in olive oil, low, 10 minutes until sweet. Peppers in, 10 minutes more.
Aubergine squeezed dry and in with a good slug more oil — aubergine drinks it and under-oiled aubergine goes leathery — 8 minutes.
Courgette and garlic, 5 minutes, then the tomatoes.

Now leave it alone on a low heat for 15 minutes, stirring rarely, until it is jammy and the oil separates out at the edges. That separation is how you know it is done; before that it is just hot vegetables.
Fry the eggs hard in olive oil so the whites go lacy and crisp at the edges.
Pisto into bowls, egg on top, manchego shaved over, baguette to mop.

avocado-toast.title: Avocado toast, properly seasoned
avocado-toast.short: The whole dish is seasoning. Under-salted avocado is the reason most versions of this taste of nothing.

ingredients.product: Le Choix du Primeur Avocat AFFINE
Cuit sur place Baguette La Généreuse
Volaé, une marque Intermarché Œufs frais de poules élevées au sol
Petit prix Tomates cerises allongées
Le Choix du Primeur Citrons JAUNES
already in the cupboard

steps: Bread into the air fryer at 190°C for 4 minutes, or under a grill. You want it dry and crisp right through — soft toast collapses under the avocado.
Poach or fry the eggs while it goes. Six-minute boiled works equally well if you would rather not stand over a pan.
Halve the avocados and scoop them into a bowl. Mash roughly with a fork — keep some lumps, a smooth purée is baby food.
Now season it much harder than feels right: the lemon juice, a real pinch of salt, plenty of pepper, a slug of olive oil. Taste it. Then add a bit more salt. This is the entire recipe.
Spread thickly on the toast, halved cherry tomatoes over, egg on top, one last grind of pepper.

pilons-airfryer-citron.title: Air fryer chicken drumsticks with lemon and thyme
pilons-airfryer-citron.short: Drumsticks in the air fryer come out with skin like crackling and no oven to heat. Twenty-five minutes, one basket.

ingredients.product: Plukon Pilons de poulet
Le Choix du Primeur Citrons JAUNES
Le Choix du Primeur Ail BLANC
Thym frais
Le Choix du Primeur Pomme de terre de consommation PRINCESSE AMANDINE à chair ferme avec traitement anti germinatif
Saint Eloi, une marque Intermarché Mélange de salades mâche et roquette prêt à l'emploi

steps: Dry the drumsticks with kitchen paper — genuinely dry, all over. Moisture is the only thing standing between you and crisp skin.
Toss with olive oil, salt, pepper, the crushed garlic, thyme leaves and the zest of the lemon.
Air fryer to 200°C. Drumsticks in a single layer, not touching. Stacked, they steam each other and the skin stays flabby.
18 minutes, turning once at 10. Add the potato chunks around them for the last 12, tossed in a little oil.
Check the thickest drumstick at the bone — the juices should run clear with no pink at all.
Squeeze the lemon over everything the moment it comes out, while it is hot enough to sizzle. Salad alongside.

frites-patates-douces-airfryer.title: Air fryer sweet potato fries
frites-patates-douces-airfryer.short: The cornflour is not optional — it is the only way sweet potato goes crisp instead of floppy.

ingredients.product: Le Choix du Primeur Patates DOUCES
Maïzena fécule de maïs
Bouton d’Or, une marque Intermarché Mayonnaise
Le Choix du Primeur Ail BLANC
already in the cupboard

steps: Cut the sweet potatoes into batons about a centimetre thick. Even thickness matters more than the exact size — mixed sizes give you burnt thin ones and raw fat ones.
Soak them in cold water for 10 minutes to pull out surface starch, then dry them thoroughly. Wet chips steam.
Toss with a tablespoon of cornflour until dusty, then a tablespoon of oil. Cornflour first, oil second, or it clumps.
Air fryer 200°C, single layer, 18–20 minutes, shaking the basket twice. Cook in two batches rather than crowding it.
Salt the moment they come out, not before — salt in the basket draws water and softens them.
Stir the crushed garlic into the mayonnaise for a dip.

dinde-panee-airfryer.title: Air fryer breaded turkey escalope
dinde-panee-airfryer.short: A milanese without a pan of hot oil. Parmesan in the crumb is what makes it taste of something.

ingredients.product: Volaé, une marque Intermarché Escalopes de dinde extra fines x2
Chapelure
Itinéraire des Saveurs, une marque Intermarché Grana Padano AOP râpé
Volaé, une marque Intermarché Œufs frais de poules élevées au sol
Top Budget Farine de blé Type 55
Le Choix du Primeur Citrons JAUNES
Saint Eloi, une marque Intermarché Roquette prête à l'emploi déjà lavée

steps: Three shallow plates: seasoned flour, beaten egg, and the breadcrumbs mixed with the parmesan.
Pat the escalopes dry, then flour, egg, crumb — pressing the crumb on firmly. Shake off the excess flour properly or the coating slides off in sheets.
Spray or brush both sides with oil. An air fryer will not brown a dry crumb; it just goes pale and dusty.
190°C, 7 minutes, flip, 5–7 minutes more until deep gold.
Lemon squeezed over, rocket alongside dressed in oil and salt.

legumes-rotis-airfryer.title: Air fryer roasted vegetables with brebis
legumes-rotis-airfryer.short: Courgette, pepper and aubergine charred hard, then brebis crumbled over while it is still hot enough to soften.

ingredients.product: Le Choix du Primeur Courgettes LONGUES
Le Choix du Primeur Poivron ROUGE
Le Choix du Primeur Aubergines VIOLETTES
Le Choix du Primeur Oignons ROUGES
Salakis Fromage 100% brebis herbes de Provence
Vinaigre balsamique
Cuit sur place Baguette La Généreuse

steps: Cut everything to roughly 2 cm. Bigger than you would for the oven — an air fryer moves a lot of air and small pieces dry out.
Toss with olive oil and salt, then into the basket at 200°C.
20 minutes, shaking hard every 7. You are after blackened edges in places, not an even golden colour; the charred bits are the flavour.
Tip into a warm bowl, splash the balsamic over while it steams, and toss.
Crumble the brebis over so it half melts, and eat with the baguette.

muffins-oeufs-legumes.title: Egg and vegetable muffins
muffins-oeufs-legumes.short: Twelve at a time, good cold for three days. A breakfast for the mornings you don't want another sandwich.

ingredients.product: Volaé, une marque Intermarché Œufs frais de poules élevées au sol
Le Choix du Primeur Poivron ROUGE
Le Choix du Primeur Courgettes LONGUES
Pâturages, une marque Intermarché 3 fromages râpés
Le Choix du Primeur Oignons JAUNES
Persil plat

steps: Oven to 180°C. Oil a twelve-hole muffin tin properly, including the top surface between the holes — egg welds itself to bare metal.
Grate the courgette and squeeze it dry in a clean cloth. Skip this and you get twelve wet, collapsed pucks.
Soften the onion and pepper in a pan for 5 minutes; raw onion in the mix stays crunchy and sharp.
Beat the eggs with plenty of salt and pepper, stir in the vegetables, cheese and parsley.
Fill each hole about three-quarters. They rise like soufflés and then settle, so leave the room.
20 minutes, until puffed and just set with no wobble at the centre. Cool 5 minutes in the tin before easing them out with a knife.

muffins-banane-chocolat.title: Banana and dark chocolate muffins
muffins-banane-chocolat.short: The blacker the bananas the better. Dairy-free — it runs on the almond milk you already buy.

ingredients.product: Le Choix du Primeur Bananes
Top Budget Farine de blé Type 55
Daddy Sucre en poudre
Volaé, une marque Intermarché Œufs frais de poules élevées au sol
Bjorg Boisson végétale Lait d'amande vanille BIO
Vahiné Pépites de chocolat noir
Levure chimique

ingredients.item: oil and a pinch of salt
ingredients.product: already in the cupboard

steps: Oven to 190°C, papers in the muffin tin. Bananas that have gone black in the fruit bowl are the ones you want — they are sweeter and mash to nothing.
Mash the bananas thoroughly, then beat in the sugar, eggs, almond milk and 80 ml of oil.
Flour, baking powder and salt sifted over the top, plus the chocolate chips.
Fold it about ten times with a spatula and stop while it still looks lumpy and undermixed. Beating a muffin batter smooth develops the gluten and gives you rubber.
Divide between twelve papers, right to the top for a good dome.
22 minutes, until a skewer comes out with a crumb or two but no wet batter. Cool in the tin 5 minutes.

mini-quiches-muffin.title: Mini quiches lorraines
mini-quiches-muffin.short: A whole quiche's worth in twelve, cooked in a third of the time and easy to carry.

ingredients.product: Pâte brisée prête à dérouler
Herta Lardons nature
Volaé, une marque Intermarché Œufs frais de poules élevées au sol
Pâturages, une marque Intermarché Emmental français râpé
Le Choix du Primeur Oignons JAUNES
Le Choix du Primeur Salade MACHE
already in the cupboard

steps: Oven to 190°C. Cut twelve discs from the pastry with a glass, a good centimetre wider than the muffin holes, and press them in.
Lardons into a cold pan, heat to medium, 5 minutes until crisp. Onion into the rendered fat, 4 minutes. Drain off the fat or the quiches turn greasy.
Beat the eggs with salt, pepper and a scrape of nutmeg. No cream — the cheese carries it.
Lardons, onion and most of the emmental into the cases, then egg poured in to just below the pastry rim. Overfill them and they weld to the tin.
Rest of the cheese on top. 25 minutes, until set and golden.
Cool 5 minutes before lifting out. Good hot, better at room temperature.

poivrons-farcis-four.title: Stuffed peppers baked with rice and beef
poivrons-farcis-four.short: Peppers are on the always-welcome list and this is the best thing to do with four of them. The rice goes in raw and cooks inside the pepper.

ingredients.product: Le Choix du Primeur Poivron ROUGE
Le Choix du Primeur Poivrons JAUNES
Jean Rozé, une marque Intermarché Viande hachée vrac pur BŒUF 15% MG
Taureau Ailé Riz Basmati
Panzani Sauce Tomates Provençale ingrédients origine naturelle
Le Choix du Primeur Oignons JAUNES
Le Choix du Primeur Ail BLANC
Persil plat

steps: Oven to 180°C. Cut the tops off the peppers and keep them; pull out the seeds and the white ribs.
Brown the mince hard in a pan, 5 minutes, without stirring much. Then the onion, 4 minutes, and the garlic.

Off the heat, stir in the raw rice, half the tomato sauce, the parsley and plenty of salt. Raw rice, not cooked — it swells inside the pepper and takes the meat juices with it. Cooked rice turns to mush.
Stand the peppers in a casserole dish, fill them about three-quarters, and put their lids back on.
Pour the rest of the sauce and 150 ml water around the base, cover the dish with foil, and bake 35 minutes.
Foil off, 10 minutes more to colour the tops. Test the rice through the side of a pepper with a knife; if it is still firm, another 5 minutes covered.

gratin-coquillettes-jambon.title: Baked coquillettes with ham
gratin-coquillettes-jambon.short: The French childhood pasta bake, made without a béchamel — the pasta finishes cooking in the milk it bakes in.

ingredients.product: Fiorini, une marque Intermarché Coquillettes
Jambon blanc en tranches
Pâturages, une marque Intermarché Emmental français râpé
Le Choix du Primeur Oignons JAUNES
Pâturages, une marque Intermarché Lait demi-écrémé stérilisé UHT BIO - issu de l'agriculture biologique,
Le Choix du Primeur Laitue FEUILLES DE CHENES BLONDE
already in the cupboard

steps: Oven to 180°C. Boil the coquillettes for 4 minutes only — half the packet time. They drink the milk in the oven and finish there; fully cooked pasta turns to paste.
Soften the onion in butter, 5 minutes.
Drain the pasta and mix in the dish with the onion, torn ham, two-thirds of the cheese, the milk, salt, pepper and a good scrape of nutmeg.
Rest of the cheese over the top.
30 minutes, until the top is brown and the edges are bubbling. If it looks wet at 25 minutes, give it another five uncovered.
Stand 5 minutes, and eat with a sharp green salad — it needs the contrast.

tian-provencal.title: Tian provençal
tian-provencal.short: Courgette, aubergine and tomato stood on edge in a dish and baked slowly until they shrink and sweeten. Almost no work.

ingredients.product: Le Choix du Primeur Courgettes LONGUES
Le Choix du Primeur Aubergines VIOLETTES
Le Choix du Primeur Tomate RONDE en GRAPPE
Le Choix du Primeur Oignons JAUNES
Le Choix du Primeur Ail BLANC
Herbes de Provence fraîches
Bouton d’Or, une marque Intermarché Huile d'olive vierge extra BIO - issue de l'agriculture biologique
Taureau Ailé Riz Basmati

steps: Oven to 180°C. Soften the sliced onions and garlic in olive oil for 10 minutes and spread them over the base of the dish. This layer is what stops the whole thing sticking and drying out.
Slice the courgette, aubergine and tomato into rounds of the same thickness, about 5 mm. Same thickness matters — mixed thicknesses cook unevenly and some stay raw.
Stand them on edge in tight alternating rows, packed hard against each other. They shrink a lot, and a loosely packed tian collapses into a puddle.
Salt, pepper, the herbs tucked in, and a generous pour of olive oil over the whole surface.
50 minutes. It is done when the tops are browned and the vegetables have sunk to about two-thirds of their original height.
Better warm than hot, and better still the next day. Rice or bread alongside.

poulet-tomates-olives-four.title: Roast chicken thighs with tomatoes and olives
poulet-tomates-olives-four.short: One dish, forty-five minutes, no stirring. The tomatoes burst and turn into the sauce by themselves.

ingredients.product: Volaé, une marque Intermarché Cuisse de poulet jaune x4
Petit prix Tomates cerises allongées
Olives noires dénoyautées
Le Choix du Primeur Oignons ROUGES
Le Choix du Primeur Ail BLANC
Le Choix du Primeur Citrons JAUNES
Romarin frais
Le Choix du Primeur Pomme de terre de consommation PRINCESSE AMANDINE à chair ferme avec traitement anti germinatif

steps: Oven to 200°C. Halve the potatoes and put them in the dish with the onion wedges, the halved garlic head and the rosemary, tossed in olive oil and salt.
Dry the chicken thighs, salt the skin hard, and sit them on top — skin up, and not touching each other. Anything laid on top of them steams them.
25 minutes.
Scatter the cherry tomatoes, olives and lemon wedges around the chicken, and give it 20 minutes more.
The tomatoes should have burst and gone jammy and the skin should be crisp. If the skin is still pale, three minutes under the grill fixes it.
Squeeze the roasted garlic cloves out of their skins and mash them into the pan juices before serving.

pain-perdu.title: Pain perdu
pain-perdu.short: What yesterday's baguette is for. Made with the vanilla almond milk, so there is no cow's milk in it.

ingredients.product: Cuit sur place Baguette La Généreuse
Volaé, une marque Intermarché Œufs frais de poules élevées au sol
Bjorg Boisson végétale Lait d'amande vanille BIO
Daddy Sucre en poudre
Le Choix du Primeur Bananes
Bouton d’Or, une marque Intermarché Cannelle moulue
already in the fridge

steps: Beat the eggs, almond milk, one tablespoon of the sugar and the cinnamon in a wide shallow dish.
Cut the baguette into 3 cm slices, on a steep angle for more surface.
Soak them for a full minute a side. Stale bread needs it; a quick dip leaves a dry core, which is the usual failure.
Butter in a pan on medium — not high. Too hot and the outside browns while the custard inside stays raw.
3 minutes a side until deep gold and puffed.
Banana over, the last of the sugar scattered on while hot.

oeufs-tomate-four.title: Eggs baked in tomato sauce
oeufs-tomate-four.short: Uova in purgatorio — normally made hot with chilli, which is exactly what we leave out. Garlic and oregano carry it instead.

ingredients.product: Panzani Sauce Tomates Provençale ingrédients origine naturelle
Volaé, une marque Intermarché Œufs frais de poules élevées au sol
Le Choix du Primeur Ail BLANC
Itinéraire des Saveurs, une marque Intermarché Grana Padano AOP râpé
Cuit sur place Baguette La Généreuse
Basilic frais en pot

steps: Oven to 200°C. Soften the sliced garlic in olive oil in an ovenproof dish over a low heat, 2 minutes, without letting it colour.
Tomato sauce in with a splash of water, and simmer 5 minutes so it thickens slightly.
Make four wells with the back of a spoon and crack an egg into each. Deep wells — a shallow one lets the white spread across the whole surface.
Season the eggs, parmesan over the sauce but not the yolks, and into the oven.
8–10 minutes. Pull it when the whites are just set and the yolks still move when you shake the dish; they carry on cooking in the hot sauce.
Basil over, baguette to mop.

soupe-oignon-gratinee.title: Soupe à l'oignon gratinée
soupe-oignon-gratinee.short: Replaces the leek and potato soup, which Méré cannot supply. Forty minutes of browning onions and nothing else — there is no shortcut and no substitute for the time.

ingredients.product: Le Choix du Primeur Oignons JAUNES
Cuit sur place Baguette La Généreuse
Pâturages, une marque Intermarché Emmental français râpé
Le Choix du Primeur Ail BLANC
Vin blanc sec de cuisine
Bouillon de bœuf en cubes
already in the fridge

steps: Slice the onions as thinly as you can manage. A kilo looks absurd in the pan and cooks down to almost nothing.

Butter and a little oil in a wide heavy pan on medium-low. Onions in with a good pinch of salt, and now give them 40 minutes, stirring every five. This is the entire recipe. Rushed onions taste sharp and the soup never recovers.
They are ready when they are deep brown and jammy, not blond. If they catch, a splash of water lifts the fond back into them.
Garlic, 1 minute. Wine in, and scrape the base clean while it bubbles down by half.
Stock in, simmer 15 minutes, season hard.
Toast the baguette slices. Ladle the soup into ovenproof bowls, float the bread, pile the cheese on top.
Under a hot grill or in a 220°C oven until the cheese blisters and runs down the sides, about 5 minutes.
